take: Carolina announced it recalled forward Felix Unger Sörum from Chicago (AHL) and placed Jordan Staal on injured reserve. Staal, without a goal in six games, has been on the ice for 45% of the five-on-five expected goals (a measure of chance quality), and the team's share has been better without him. Unger Sörum, in two games, sits at 67% over his small sample. Staal has missed four games, and Mark Jankowski has taken his spot beside Martinook and Ehlers.
